entries.title: Paladin's Challenge
entries.body:
# Paladin's Challenge

## Overview
A Paladin is more than a warrior clad in heavy armour—they are the shield that stands between the innocent and those who would bring them harm. Through unwavering conviction and absolute faith, a Paladin can issue a sacred challenge that demands the attention of friend and foe alike.

When you invoke **Paladin's Challenge**, you openly declare yourself as the greatest threat upon the battlefield. Your voice carries the authority of your oath, compelling enemies to acknowledge your presence and confront you before those who cannot defend themselves. It is not an enchantment that dominates the mind, but a divine proclamation that weighs heavily upon the conscience and instincts of those who hear it.

Experienced Paladins understand that protection is not achieved by simply enduring punishment—it begins by ensuring the enemy's focus remains where it belongs. Every successful challenge allows your allies the opportunity to reposition, recover, or strike while you hold the front line against overwhelming odds.

## Rank 1
### Description

A Paladin is more than a warrior clad in heavy armour—they are the shield that stands between the innocent and those who would bring them harm. Through unwavering conviction and absolute faith, a Paladin can issue a sacred challenge that demands the attention of friend and foe alike.

When you invoke **Paladin's Challenge**, you openly declare yourself as the greatest threat upon the battlefield. Your voice carries the authority of your oath, compelling enemies to acknowledge your presence and confront you before those who cannot defend themselves. It is not an enchantment that dominates the mind, but a divine proclamation that weighs heavily upon the conscience and instincts of those who hear it.

Experienced Paladins understand that protection is not achieved by simply enduring punishment—it begins by ensuring the enemy's focus remains where it belongs. Every successful challenge allows your allies the opportunity to reposition, recover, or strike while you hold the front line against overwhelming odds.

### Effects

- Spend **20 MP** to issue a **Divine Challenge**.
- Choose one creature within **15 metres** that can see or hear you.
- The target must make a **Wisdom Saving Throw**.
- **Saving Throw DC = 10 + your Charisma Modifier + your Proficiency Bonus.**
- On a failed save, the target becomes **Challenged** for **2 Rounds**.
- A **Challenged** creature treats you as its primary combat target whenever it is reasonable to do so.
- A **Challenged** creature suffers **−2 to Attack Rolls** made against creatures other than you.
- The challenge immediately ends if you are reduced to **0 HP**.
- A creature may ignore the challenge if you become unreachable or another ability forces it to target a different creature.
- Bosses, Legendary creatures, and creatures of a significantly higher Threat Tier may gain Advantage on their Saving Throw at the GM's discretion.
- Your chosen patron's **Divine Authority** may grant additional bonuses against creatures that oppose its divine domain. See your patron's **Divine Authority** page for details.

### Lore

Among the knightly orders of Asteria, the Divine Challenge is considered a sacred promise rather than a battle cry. By speaking these words, a Paladin willingly places themselves between danger and those under their protection, accepting whatever consequences follow.

Veterans often teach that courage is not measured by the number of enemies defeated, but by the willingness to stand before impossible odds without yielding. To answer a Paladin's challenge is to confront not only the warrior before you, but the unwavering conviction of the divine power that guides them.

> *"If your hatred seeks the innocent, then let it first break itself against my shield."*  
> **— Sir Garrick Dawnshield, High Protector of the Argent Bastion**

## Rank 2
### Description

Your conviction grows stronger, carrying your challenge beyond a single foe. Through steadfast faith and commanding presence, you draw the attention of multiple enemies, placing yourself at the centre of the battle and giving your allies the opportunity to act without constant pressure.

A seasoned Paladin understands that protecting others is not achieved through brute strength alone. It requires absolute confidence, an unbreakable will, and the courage to become the enemy's greatest obstacle. Those who answer your challenge find it increasingly difficult to ignore the warrior who stands before them, shield raised and oath unbroken.

Every successful challenge reinforces your role as the defender of your companions, allowing you to dictate the flow of combat through unwavering resolve rather than fear or domination.

### Effects

- Spend **30 MP** to issue a **Divine Challenge**.
- Choose up to **2 creatures** within **15 metres** that can see or hear you.
- Each target must make a **Wisdom Saving Throw**.
- **Saving Throw DC = 10 + your Charisma Modifier + your Proficiency Bonus.**
- On a failed save, the target becomes **Challenged** for **2 Rounds**.
- A **Challenged** creature treats you as its primary combat target whenever it is reasonable to do so.
- A **Challenged** creature suffers **−4 to Attack Rolls** made against creatures other than you.
- The challenge immediately ends for a creature if you are reduced to **0 HP**.
- A creature may ignore the challenge if you become unreachable or another ability forces it to attack a different target.
- Bosses, Legendary creatures, and creatures of a significantly higher Threat Tier may gain Advantage on their Saving Throw at the GM's discretion.
- Apply any additional bonuses granted by your patron's **Divine Authority**, if applicable.

### Lore

As Paladins gain experience, their presence alone becomes enough to command the attention of those around them. Their voice carries the weight of countless vows upheld and countless battles survived, causing even disciplined warriors to hesitate before looking past them.

Among the great knightly orders, mastering the challenge of multiple foes is considered a defining milestone. It marks the moment a Paladin ceases to be merely a protector of individuals and becomes the steadfast guardian of the battlefield itself.

> *"A shield protects one life. A true Paladin protects everyone standing behind it."*  
> **— Dame Elowyn, Captain of the Silver Wardens**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your divine authority has become impossible to ignore. Your challenge now echoes across the battlefield, drawing the attention of multiple enemies and forcing them to confront the living embodiment of your oath. Those who attempt to disregard your presence find their resolve shaken as the weight of your conviction bears down upon them.

Veteran Paladins understand that a challenge is more than a declaration of courage—it is a promise. You vow to stand between danger and those under your protection, and your enemies instinctively recognise that promise. While they may resist your authority, every moment spent ignoring you becomes increasingly difficult, allowing your allies to fight under the shelter of your unwavering resolve.

### Effects

- Spend **40 MP** to issue a **Divine Challenge**.
- Choose up to **3 creatures** within **20 metres** that can see or hear you.
- Each target must make a **Wisdom Saving Throw**.
- **Saving Throw DC = 10 + your Charisma Modifier + your Proficiency Bonus.**
- On a failed save, the target becomes **Challenged** for **3 Rounds**.
- A **Challenged** creature treats you as its primary combat target whenever it is reasonable to do so.
- A **Challenged** creature suffers **−6 to Attack Rolls** made against creatures other than you.
- If a **Challenged** creature willingly attacks another target while you are a valid target, it suffers **Radiant damage equal to your Charisma Modifier** immediately after resolving its attack.
- The challenge immediately ends for a creature if you are reduced to **0 HP**.
- A creature may ignore the challenge if you become unreachable or another effect forces it to attack a different target.
- Bosses, Legendary creatures and creatures of a significantly higher Threat Tier may gain Advantage on their Saving Throw at the GM's discretion.
- Apply any additional bonuses granted by your patron's **Divine Authority**, if applicable.

### Lore

The greatest defenders are remembered not for the enemies they slew, but for the lives they preserved. A seasoned Paladin's challenge is no longer merely heard—it is felt. Those who witness it often describe an overwhelming certainty that the warrior before them cannot simply be ignored.

Many scriptures describe this as the moment a Paladin truly becomes a guardian. Their presence alone changes the course of battle, compelling allies to stand taller while forcing their enemies to confront the consequences of misplaced aggression.

> *"Ignore my warning if you must. The light will remember your choice."*  
> **— High Justicar Alaric, Keeper of the Sacred Bastion**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your divine presence has become impossible to ignore. Rather than issuing a challenge to individual foes, your conviction radiates across the battlefield, demanding the attention of every enemy that dares approach.

To stand before a veteran Paladin is to face the living embodiment of their oath. Every strike against an ally becomes a conscious rejection of your divine authority, while every step toward you is met with unwavering resolve. Even disciplined warriors find themselves instinctively drawn toward the greatest threat—the steadfast protector standing before them.

Your challenge no longer protects a single companion. It establishes a defensive bastion wherever you stand, allowing your allies to fight beneath the shelter of your conviction.

### Effects

- Spend **50 MP** to issue a **Divine Challenge**.
- All hostile creatures within a **10 metre radius** that can see or hear you must make a **Wisdom Saving Throw**.
- **Saving Throw DC = 10 + your Charisma Modifier + your Proficiency Bonus.**
- On a failed save, a creature becomes **Challenged** for **3 Rounds**.
- Challenged creatures treat you as their primary combat target whenever it is reasonable to do so.
- Challenged creatures suffer **−6 to Attack Rolls** made against creatures other than you.
- If a Challenged creature willingly attacks another target while you are a valid target, it suffers **Radiant Damage equal to twice your Charisma Modifier** after its attack resolves.
- Challenged creatures cannot willingly move further away from you unless forced by another effect or they succeed on a new Wisdom Saving Throw at the end of their turn.
- The challenge immediately ends for a creature if you are reduced to **0 HP**.
- Bosses, Legendary creatures and creatures of a significantly higher Threat Tier may gain Advantage on their Saving Throw at the GM's discretion.
- Apply any additional bonuses granted by your patron's **Divine Authority**, if applicable.

### Lore

There comes a point where a Paladin no longer needs to seek the attention of evil—evil instinctively recognises them. Veterans of countless campaigns speak of battlefields falling strangely silent as a single knight steps forward, shield raised, daring every foe to pass.

Those who have witnessed such champions often describe the experience as standing before an immovable fortress. Their conviction is so absolute that even the most bloodthirsty monsters find their instincts drawn toward the greatest obstacle before them, unable to ignore the guardian who refuses to yield.

> *"Stand behind me and fear nothing. Stand before me and fear everything."*  
> **— Grandmaster Roland Ashbourne, First Shield of the Dawn**

## Rank 5
### Description

Your challenge has become a divine command that echoes across the battlefield. The strength of your conviction radiates from your very presence, compelling enemies to acknowledge you as the greatest obstacle between them and their quarry.

Those who stand beside you fight beneath the protection of an unbreakable oath, while those who oppose you feel the crushing weight of divine judgement. Though creatures still possess the freedom to resist your challenge, few can ignore the unwavering authority carried by a legendary Paladin.

Masters of this technique are remembered as living bulwarks. Entire battle lines have broken against their shields, not because they were impossible to defeat, but because no enemy could simply walk past them without paying a terrible price.

### Effects

- Spend **60 MP** to issue a **Divine Challenge**.
- All hostile creatures within a **15 metre radius** that can see or hear you must make a **Wisdom Saving Throw**.
- **Saving Throw DC = 10 + your Charisma Modifier + your Proficiency Bonus.**
- On a failed save, creatures become **Challenged** for **4 Rounds**.
- Challenged creatures treat you as their primary combat target whenever it is reasonable to do so.
- Challenged creatures suffer **−6 to Attack Rolls** made against creatures other than you.
- If a Challenged creature willingly attacks another target while you remain a valid target, it immediately suffers **Radiant Damage equal to twice your Charisma Modifier** after resolving its attack.
- Challenged creatures provoke an **Opportunity Attack** from you if they willingly move away from you while within your reach.
- A Challenged creature may only attempt a new Wisdom Saving Throw at the end of its turn if you become unreachable or another effect prevents it from engaging you.
- The challenge immediately ends if you are reduced to **0 HP**.
- Bosses, Legendary creatures and creatures of a significantly higher Threat Tier may gain Advantage on their initial Saving Throw at the GM's discretion.
- Apply any bonuses granted by your patron's **Divine Authority**, if applicable.

### Lore

Among the greatest champions of Asteria, a Paladin's Challenge is spoken of with reverence. It is said that when such a Paladin plants their feet upon the battlefield and issues their sacred declaration, even the bravest warriors instinctively turn their attention toward them.

The challenge is not born from arrogance, but from sacrifice. Every word is a promise that no ally shall face the darkness alone while the Paladin still stands. Those who witness such resolve often discover that true courage is not measured by the enemies one defeats, but by the burdens one willingly bears for others.

> *"Come then. Let every blade, every spell and every ounce of your hatred fall upon me. My oath was forged to carry it."*  
> **— Saint Garrick, First Shield of the Radiant Host**

## Prerequisites
None

## Scaling
See individual rank details.

## Synergy
Information coming soon.

## GM Notes
GM-only information coming soon.

entries.title: Paladin's Charge
entries.body:
# Paladin's Charge

## Overview
A Paladin does not hesitate once judgement has been made.

Paladin's Charge is a disciplined burst of speed that allows you to rapidly close the distance between yourself and an enemy or objective. Rather than relying upon agility or trickery, you commit your entire body and conviction to a single, unwavering advance.

Once your charge begins there is no turning back. Your momentum carries you forward until you reach your destination, collide with an obstacle, or strike your target. Mastering this technique teaches every Paladin that commitment is a weapon in itself—one that can break enemy lines just as surely as any blade.

## Rank 1
### Description

A Paladin does not hesitate once judgement has been made.

Paladin's Charge is a disciplined burst of speed that allows you to rapidly close the distance between yourself and an enemy or objective. Rather than relying upon agility or trickery, you commit your entire body and conviction to a single, unwavering advance.

Once your charge begins there is no turning back. Your momentum carries you forward until you reach your destination, collide with an obstacle, or strike your target. Mastering this technique teaches every Paladin that commitment is a weapon in itself—one that can break enemy lines just as surely as any blade.

### Effects

- Spend **15 Stamina** to immediately charge up to **10 metres** in a straight line.
- The direction of the charge is chosen when activated.
- Once the charge begins you:
  - Cannot voluntarily stop.
  - Cannot change direction.
  - Continue until you reach the maximum distance, collide with terrain, or hit your chosen target.
- This movement does **not** provoke Opportunity Attacks from creatures you move past during the charge.

#### Impact

If your charge ends by colliding with an enemy, that creature must make an **Agility Saving Throw**.

**Save DC = 10 + Strength Modifier**

- **Success:** The target holds its ground.
- **Failure:** The target is pushed **2 metres** directly away from you.
- **Critical Failure:** The target is pushed **2 metres**, knocked **Prone**, and must spend movement to stand on its next turn.

Large or firmly anchored creatures may receive Advantage on this saving throw at the GM's discretion.

### Lore

Among the knightly orders of Asteria, recruits spend weeks learning that a charge is not merely running towards an enemy. It is an act of complete commitment. Doubt causes hesitation, hesitation weakens momentum, and lost momentum has claimed the lives of countless warriors.

Veteran Paladins are recognised by the confidence with which they advance. When they lower their shoulder and begin their charge, few stand willingly in their path. Even creatures many times their size learn that faith, discipline, and momentum can strike with astonishing force.

> *"When your conviction is true, every step becomes a weapon."*  
> — Sir Aldren, Commander of the Dawn Guard

## Rank 2
### Description

With experience comes confidence. Your charge is no longer a reckless rush, but a disciplined advance that carries greater force and purpose. Every step is measured, every impact deliberate, allowing you to cover greater ground while maintaining complete control over your momentum.

Seasoned Paladins learn that hesitation is the enemy of conviction. Once they commit to a charge, they become an unstoppable force until their objective is reached. Whether breaking an enemy's formation or crashing into a powerful foe, their momentum alone is enough to make even seasoned warriors brace for impact.

### Effects

- Spend **15 Stamina** to immediately charge up to **15 metres** in a straight line.
- The direction of the charge is chosen when activated.
- Once the charge begins you:
  - Cannot voluntarily stop.
  - Cannot change direction.
  - Continue until you reach the maximum distance, collide with terrain, or hit your chosen target.
- This movement does **not** provoke Opportunity Attacks from creatures you move past during the charge.
- Difficult Terrain does not reduce the movement distance of your charge.

#### Impact

If your charge ends by colliding with an enemy, that creature must make an **Agility Saving Throw**.

**Save DC = 10 + Strength Modifier + Proficiency Bonus**

- **Success:** The target holds its ground.
- **Failure:** The target is pushed **3 metres** directly away from you.
- **Critical Failure:** The target is pushed **3 metres**, knocked **Prone**, and must spend movement to stand on its next turn.

Creatures one or more size categories larger than you have Advantage on this saving throw unless otherwise stated by another ability.

### Lore

As Paladins mature in both faith and discipline, their charge becomes an extension of their conviction. Every stride carries the weight of unwavering purpose, driving them forward through mud, rubble, and fear alike.

Those who have stood before an experienced Paladin often recall the same feeling—a single heartbeat where the battlefield falls silent before an unstoppable wall of steel and determination crashes into them.

> *"Conviction carries farther than the strongest legs ever could."*  
> — Dame Elowyn, Knight-Captain of the Argent Bastion

## Rank 3
### Description

Your charge has become a symbol of unwavering resolve. Every step carries the weight of your conviction, allowing you to surge through difficult terrain and lesser obstacles without breaking your momentum. To those who stand against you, it is like watching a living battering ram blessed by the divine.

A seasoned Paladin understands that hesitation is defeat. Once the charge begins there is only one destination—the enemy before them. Whether leading the front line or breaking an entrenched defence, your momentum becomes as much a weapon as the blade in your hand.

### Effects

- Spend **20 Stamina** to immediately charge up to **20 metres** in a straight line.
- The direction of the charge is chosen when activated.
- Once the charge begins you:
  - Cannot voluntarily stop.
  - Cannot change direction.
  - Continue until you reach the maximum distance, collide with an immovable obstacle, or hit your chosen target.
- This movement does **not** provoke Opportunity Attacks.
- Your charge ignores **Difficult Terrain**.
- During the charge you may smash through:
  - Wooden furniture
  - Barricades
  - Doors
  - Other fragile environmental objects
  *(GM discretion.)*

#### Impact

If your charge ends by colliding with an enemy, that creature must make an **Agility Saving Throw**.

**Save DC = 10 + Strength Modifier + Proficiency Bonus**

- **Success:** The creature holds its ground.
- **Failure:** The creature is pushed **4 metres** directly away from you.
- **Critical Failure:** The creature is pushed **4 metres**, knocked **Prone**, and is **Staggered** until the end of its next turn.

**Staggered**
- Movement Speed is reduced by **50%**.
- The creature cannot take Reactions until the condition ends.

Creatures one or more size categories larger than you have Advantage on this saving throw unless otherwise stated by another ability.

### Lore

Every Paladin Order teaches that a charge is an act of faith before it is an act of war. The knight commits completely, trusting in discipline, conviction, and the strength granted by their oath. There can be no uncertainty once the first step is taken.

Veterans are remembered not for the battles they survived, but for the moments they shattered impossible odds with a single relentless advance. Entire shield walls have broken beneath the momentum of a determined Paladin, their enemies realising too late that the charge could never be stopped.

> *"Walls are built to halt armies. Conviction was never one of them."*  
> — High Marshal Edric of the Radiant Host

## Rank 4
### Description

Your charge becomes an overwhelming display of divine resolve. Few possess the strength to halt your advance, and those who stand before you are often thrown aside as your momentum carries you relentlessly toward your chosen destination.

To seasoned Paladins, the charge is no longer simply a means of closing the distance—it is a declaration. Every step announces the arrival of unwavering justice, breaking enemy formations and forcing even veteran warriors to reconsider holding their ground.

Those who attempt to stand against your advance quickly learn that conviction possesses a force all its own.

### Effects

- Spend **25 Stamina** to immediately charge up to **25 metres** in a straight line.
- The direction of the charge is chosen when activated.
- Once the charge begins you:
  - Cannot voluntarily stop.
  - Cannot change direction.
  - Continue until you reach your maximum distance or collide with an immovable obstacle.
- Your charge ignores **Difficult Terrain**.
- Your movement during the charge does **not** provoke Opportunity Attacks.
- You may smash through fragile objects such as wooden barricades, doors, fences and similar environmental obstacles (GM discretion).

#### Relentless Momentum

Your charge no longer ends after striking the first enemy.

Creatures that fail their Agility Saving Throw are knocked aside and your charge continues until:

- You reach your maximum distance.
- A creature successfully resists your charge.
- You collide with an immovable object.

#### Impact

Each enemy struck during the charge must make an **Agility Saving Throw**.

**Save DC = 10 + Strength Modifier + Proficiency Bonus**

- **Success:** The creature holds its ground and your charge immediately ends.
- **Failure:** The creature is pushed **5 metres** directly away from you as your charge continues.
- **Critical Failure:** The creature is pushed **5 metres**, knocked **Prone**, and becomes **Staggered** until the end of its next turn.

**Staggered**

- Movement Speed is reduced by **50%**.
- The creature cannot take Reactions until the condition ends.

Creatures one or more size categories larger than you have Advantage on this saving throw unless otherwise modified by another ability.

### Lore

Only the greatest Paladins ever master the Relentless Charge. To witness one is to see discipline transformed into unstoppable momentum, where neither fear nor resistance can slow their advance.

Entire battle lines have been broken by a single Paladin driving through the heart of an enemy formation, their unwavering conviction scattering soldiers before them like leaves before a storm. Veterans often say that by the time you hear the thunder of a charging Paladin, it is already too late to stand your ground.

> *"Justice does not ask for passage. It makes one."*  
> — Grand Commander Aurelius, Keeper of the Silver Host

## Rank 5
### Description

There comes a point where a Paladin's charge ceases to be simple movement and becomes an act of divine judgement. Every step echoes with unwavering conviction, every stride carrying the full weight of their oath toward those who would oppose it.

The battlefield itself seems to part before your advance. Lesser foes are scattered, obstacles crumble beneath your momentum, and only the strongest possess the resolve to stand against your charge. To witness such a charge is to witness absolute commitment—a warrior who has surrendered every hesitation in pursuit of justice.

Among the oldest knightly orders, reaching this level of mastery is considered one of the greatest honours a Paladin can achieve. Many legends begin with a single unstoppable charge.

### Effects

- Spend **30 Stamina** to immediately charge up to **30 metres** in a perfectly straight line.
- The direction is chosen when the ability is activated.
- Once the charge begins you:
  - Cannot voluntarily stop.
  - Cannot change direction.
  - Continue until reaching your maximum distance or colliding with an immovable object.
- Your charge ignores **Difficult Terrain**.
- Your movement during the charge does **not** provoke Opportunity Attacks.
- You may smash through fragile environmental objects such as doors, barricades, fences and similar obstacles (GM discretion).

#### Divine Momentum

Your charge continues through every creature that fails its Agility Saving Throw.

Your charge only ends when:

- You reach the maximum distance.
- You collide with an immovable object.
- A creature successfully resists your charge.

#### Impact

Each creature struck during your charge must make an **Agility Saving Throw**.

**Save DC = 10 + Strength Modifier + Proficiency Bonus**

- **Success**
  - The creature stands its ground.
  - Your charge immediately ends.

- **Failure**
  - The creature is pushed **6 metres** directly away from you.
  - Your charge continues.

- **Critical Failure**
  - The creature is pushed **6 metres**.
  - The creature is knocked **Prone**.
  - The creature becomes **Staggered** until the end of its next turn.

#### Divine Impact

If your charge ends by colliding with an enemy, your **next melee attack** against that creature before the end of your turn gains:

- **Advantage** on the attack roll.
- If that attack is **Divine Smite**, its Mana Cost is reduced by **20%** (rounded up).

### Lore

The greatest Paladins are remembered not for how many battles they fought, but for the moments when they broke impossible odds through unwavering conviction. Their charge is more than speed or strength—it is the physical manifestation of faith carried to its absolute conclusion.

Stories tell of champions who crashed through monstrous hordes, shattered fortress gates, and reached tyrants thought untouchable, all because they refused to let doubt interrupt their advance. Those who survive such a charge rarely remember the impact itself. They remember only the certainty with which it came.

> *"A charge without conviction is merely running. A charge with conviction becomes destiny."*  
> — Saint Garrick, First High Paladin

## Prerequisites
None

## Scaling
See individual rank details.

## Synergy
Information coming soon.

## GM Notes
GM-only information coming soon.

entries.title: Blessed Resilience
entries.body:
# Blessed Resilience

## Overview
Your unwavering devotion has begun to transform both body and soul. Through your sacred oath, your patron's divine essence becomes a permanent part of your being, strengthening your resolve against the forces that seek to oppose your faith.

This blessing is not armour forged from steel, but a quiet resilience carried within your spirit. Each trial endured strengthens the bond between champion and patron, allowing you to withstand hardships that would break ordinary mortals. Though the blessing is subtle at first, its influence grows with every act of devotion.

Every deity grants resilience in a different form. Rather than shielding all Paladins equally, your patron fortifies you against the divine forces it understands best, preparing you to confront those that stand in opposition to its will.

## Rank 1
### Description

Your unwavering devotion has begun to transform both body and soul. Through your sacred oath, your patron's divine essence becomes a permanent part of your being, strengthening your resolve against the forces that seek to oppose your faith.

This blessing is not armour forged from steel, but a quiet resilience carried within your spirit. Each trial endured strengthens the bond between champion and patron, allowing you to withstand hardships that would break ordinary mortals. Though the blessing is subtle at first, its influence grows with every act of devotion.

Every deity grants resilience in a different form. Rather than shielding all Paladins equally, your patron fortifies you against the divine forces it understands best, preparing you to confront those that stand in opposition to its will.

### Effects

- Blessed Resilience is a **Passive Talent** and is always active.
- Gain **+2 on Saving Throws** against effects originating from your patron's **Divine Opposition**.
- Gain **Resistance** to one damage type or supernatural effect determined by your patron's Religious pages.
- Gain **+2 on checks or Saving Throws** made to resist conditions specifically associated with your patron's Divine Opposition.
- If multiple abilities would grant the same resistance, only the strongest applies unless another rule states otherwise.
- The exact resistances and protections granted by Blessed Resilience are determined by your patron's Religious pages.

### Lore

Every divine champion bears the mark of their patron, whether visible to the eye or hidden within the soul. Over time, this sacred bond reshapes the Paladin into someone capable of enduring hardships that would overwhelm lesser warriors. Their resilience is not born of stubbornness alone, but from the certainty that their patron walks beside them.

Among the great religious orders, seasoned Paladins often recognise one another by this quiet strength. Though they may serve different deities, each carries a resilience uniquely shaped by the divine power that chose them, standing firm against the very forces their patron opposes.

> *"Faith is not proven when life is easy. It is proven by the strength to endure what seeks to break you."*  
> **— High Warden Cassian, Keeper of the Eternal Oath**

## Rank 2
### Description

The bond between you and your patron grows stronger with every trial you endure. Divine power no longer simply shields you from harm—it begins to temper your body and spirit, allowing you to withstand the very forces your deity was created to oppose.

Every wound survived and every temptation resisted reinforces your sacred connection. Your patron's essence quietly shapes your resilience, ensuring that the powers most hostile to your divine purpose find it increasingly difficult to overcome your resolve. While others may falter beneath such forces, you remain steadfast, carrying your faith as both armour and sanctuary.

To experienced Paladins, this blessing is a constant reminder that resilience is not the absence of suffering, but the ability to endure it without abandoning one's oath. Their strength is drawn not from themselves alone, but from the eternal bond shared with the divine.

### Effects

- **Blessed Resilience** is a **Passive Talent** and is always active.
- Gain **+4 on Saving Throws** against effects originating from your patron's **Divine Opposition**.
- Gain **Resistance** to one or more damage types, conditions, or supernatural effects determined by your patron's Religious pages.
- Once per **Short Rest**, when you fail a Saving Throw against your patron's Divine Opposition, you may immediately reroll that Saving Throw. You must use the second result.
- Gain **+4 on checks or Saving Throws** made to resist conditions specifically associated with your patron's Divine Opposition.
- If multiple abilities would grant the same resistance, only the strongest applies unless another rule states otherwise.
- The exact resistances, protections, and additional blessings granted by **Blessed Resilience** are determined by your patron's Religious pages.

### Lore

As the years pass, the divine blessing carried by a Paladin becomes inseparable from their very being. Their patron's influence no longer answers only when called upon—it quietly strengthens them every moment of every day, preparing them for the inevitable confrontation with the powers that stand in opposition to their faith.

Many scholars believe that this resilience is the first outward sign of true divine favour. Though different patrons bestow different blessings, all share a common purpose: to ensure their chosen champion can endure the trials they were destined to face.

> *"Steel is forged through fire. Faith is forged through adversity."*  
> **— High Warden Cassian, Keeper of the Eternal Oath**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your patron's blessing has become deeply woven into your soul, transforming your resilience from simple endurance into steadfast divine protection. The forces that oppose your deity find it increasingly difficult to weaken your resolve, as your body and spirit instinctively reject influences that seek to break your sacred oath.

Every trial survived strengthens the divine bond between champion and patron. What once required conscious determination has become second nature, allowing you to endure hardships that would overwhelm even seasoned warriors. Whether facing corrupting magic, overwhelming divine power, or supernatural afflictions tied to your patron's eternal enemies, your faith stands as an unyielding shield.

To the greatest Paladins, resilience is not measured by how little they suffer, but by how often they rise again without allowing darkness to take hold. Their patron's blessing ensures that no matter how fierce the opposition becomes, their resolve remains unbroken.

### Effects

- **Blessed Resilience** is a **Passive Talent** and is always active.
- Gain **+6 on Saving Throws** against effects originating from your patron's **Divine Opposition**.
- Gain the resistances and protections granted by your patron's Religious pages.
- Once per **Short Rest**, when you fail a Saving Throw against your patron's Divine Opposition, you may immediately reroll that Saving Throw. You must use the second result.
- If you successfully resist an effect originating from your patron's Divine Opposition, you become **immune to that same effect from the same source until the end of your next turn**.
- Gain **+6 on checks or Saving Throws** made to resist conditions specifically associated with your patron's Divine Opposition.
- If multiple abilities would grant the same resistance, only the strongest applies unless another rule states otherwise.
- The exact resistances, protections, and additional blessings granted by **Blessed Resilience** are determined by your patron's Religious pages.

### Lore

Veteran Paladins are recognised not by the absence of scars, but by the certainty with which they continue to stand against impossible odds. Their patron's blessing has become so deeply intertwined with their soul that opposing divine forces struggle to gain even the briefest foothold.

Religious scholars often describe these champions as living testaments to their deity's will. Each victory over corruption, temptation, or supernatural oppression reinforces the sacred bond they share, proving that true resilience is born not from invulnerability, but from unwavering devotion.

> *"A faithful soul does not become unbreakable by avoiding hardship. It becomes unbreakable by surviving it."*  
> **— High Warden Cassian, Keeper of the Eternal Oath**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your patron's blessing has become an inseparable part of your being. Divine power no longer merely protects you—it instinctively responds whenever opposing forces attempt to weaken your resolve. Every trial endured has forged your body, mind, and spirit into a vessel capable of withstanding extraordinary hardship.

The champions who reach this level of devotion are often described as immovable pillars of faith. They continue advancing through corruption, fear, divine opposition, and supernatural assaults that would overwhelm lesser warriors. Their resilience is no longer a conscious effort but an instinct born from absolute trust in their patron.

Those who witness such unwavering determination often mistake it for invulnerability. In truth, a Paladin still feels pain and hardship—but their faith refuses to let those burdens define them.

### Effects

- **Blessed Resilience** is a **Passive Talent** and is always active.
- Gain **+6 on Saving Throws** against effects originating from your patron's **Divine Opposition**.
- Gain all resistances and protections granted by your patron's Religious pages.
- Once per **Short Rest**, when you fail a Saving Throw against your patron's Divine Opposition, you may immediately reroll that Saving Throw. You must use the second result.
- If you successfully resist an effect originating from your patron's Divine Opposition, you become **immune to that same effect from the same source until the end of your next turn**.
- The first time each **Long Rest** that you would gain a condition associated with your patron's **Divine Opposition**, you may choose to ignore that condition entirely.
- If multiple abilities would grant the same resistance or immunity, only the strongest applies unless another rule states otherwise.
- The exact resistances, immunities, and blessings granted by **Blessed Resilience** are determined by your patron's Religious pages.

### Lore

The oldest scriptures speak of champions whose faith became so complete that the divine itself seemed to shield them from corruption. Though wounds still marked their bodies, their spirits remained beyond the reach of the powers that sought to break them.

Among the greatest Paladins, Blessed Resilience is viewed not as a reward, but as a sacred responsibility. Those entrusted with such unwavering protection are expected to stand where others cannot, shielding the innocent from the very forces their patron has sworn to oppose.

> *"The faithful are not those who never fall. They are those who rise every time darkness believes it has finally won."*  
> **— High Warden Cassian, Keeper of the Eternal Oath**

## Rank 5
### Description

Your soul has become a living reflection of your patron's divine will. Every hardship you have endured, every temptation resisted, and every oath upheld has strengthened the sacred bond between you and the deity you serve. What was once a blessing has become an inseparable part of your very existence.

Opposing divine forces no longer see you as merely another mortal champion—they recognise you as an extension of the power they oppose. Your faith shields your body, your spirit, and your resolve, allowing you to stand before supernatural threats that would overwhelm even the greatest heroes.

Though no mortal is beyond suffering, your patron ensures that you will never stand alone. Their presence surrounds you in every battle, every trial, and every act of devotion, making you one of the truest embodiments of their divine purpose.

### Effects

- **Blessed Resilience** is a **Passive Talent** and is always active.
- Gain **Advantage on Saving Throws** against effects originating from your patron's **Divine Opposition**.
- Gain all resistances, protections, and passive blessings granted by your patron's Religious pages.
- Once per **Short Rest**, when you fail a Saving Throw against your patron's Divine Opposition, you may immediately reroll that Saving Throw. You must use the second result.
- If you successfully resist an effect originating from your patron's Divine Opposition, you become **immune to that same effect from the same source for 1 minute**.
- The first time each **Long Rest** that you would gain a condition associated with your patron's Divine Opposition, you may ignore that condition entirely.
- Gain your patron's **Legendary Blessing**, as described in your patron's Religious pages.
- If multiple abilities would grant the same resistance, protection, or immunity, only the strongest applies unless another rule states otherwise.

### Lore

Few Paladins ever achieve such complete harmony with their patron. Those who do become living symbols of divine conviction, carrying the essence of their deity wherever they travel. Entire orders look to these champions for guidance, believing their unwavering resilience to be proof that absolute faith can overcome even the greatest darkness.

Legends speak of these heroes standing against impossible odds without yielding, not because they were invincible, but because their devotion could not be shaken. Whether defending sacred shrines, confronting ancient evils, or leading armies into hopeless battles, they become a testament to the enduring strength of the divine.

> *"The body may tire. The armour may break. Even the sword may fail. But a soul truly bound to the divine will never surrender."*  
> **— High Warden Cassian, Keeper of the Eternal Oath**

## Prerequisites
None

## Scaling
See individual rank details.

## Synergy
Information coming soon.

## GM Notes
GM-only information coming soon.

entries.title: Divine Smite
entries.body:
# Divine Smite

## Overview
A Paladin's weapon is more than forged steel—it is an extension of the sacred oath they have sworn. Through prayer and unwavering conviction, you call upon your patron's divine essence, allowing a single strike to carry the judgement of the deity you serve.

Every Divine Smite is unique to its wielder. The manifestation of the power reflects the nature of the chosen patron, surging through the weapon as radiant light, spectral souls, raging flame, shadow, living vines, celestial energy, infernal wrath, or countless other divine expressions. Though its appearance differs, each smite carries the unmistakable authority of a champion acting in their patron's name.

The power of Divine Smite is especially devastating against those who stand in direct opposition to your patron. Your deity's eternal conflict resonates through your weapon, causing the strike to burn brighter, strike harder, or manifest with greater force against those aligned with the opposing divine domain.

## Rank 1
### Description

A Paladin's weapon is more than forged steel—it is an extension of the sacred oath they have sworn. Through prayer and unwavering conviction, you call upon your patron's divine essence, allowing a single strike to carry the judgement of the deity you serve.

Every Divine Smite is unique to its wielder. The manifestation of the power reflects the nature of the chosen patron, surging through the weapon as radiant light, spectral souls, raging flame, shadow, living vines, celestial energy, infernal wrath, or countless other divine expressions. Though its appearance differs, each smite carries the unmistakable authority of a champion acting in their patron's name.

The power of Divine Smite is especially devastating against those who stand in direct opposition to your patron. Your deity's eternal conflict resonates through your weapon, causing the strike to burn brighter, strike harder, or manifest with greater force against those aligned with the opposing divine domain.

### Effects

- Spend **25 MP** immediately before or immediately after hitting a creature with a melee weapon attack.
- The triggering attack deals an additional **2d8 Patron Damage**.
- Your patron determines the **damage type**, visual manifestation, and other interactions of this damage through its Religious pages.
- If the target belongs to your patron's **Divine Opposition**, increase the additional damage to **3d8 Patron Damage**.
- Divine Smite may only be activated **once per turn**.
- Divine Smite cannot be activated if the triggering attack misses.
- Additional effects granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** are applied after resolving the damage, where applicable.

### Lore

Since the earliest days of Asteria, Divine Smite has stood as the defining miracle of every Paladin. It is not simply a stronger attack, but a moment where mortal conviction and divine purpose become one. For a brief instant, the champion's weapon ceases to belong solely to them and instead becomes a conduit for their patron's will.

Although every faith teaches the technique differently, all agree upon one truth: a Divine Smite is never an act of anger alone. It is a declaration of purpose. Every empowered strike reminds both ally and enemy that the Paladin does not fight for personal glory, but as a faithful servant carrying out the judgement of the deity they have sworn to uphold.

> *"The weapon is mine to wield. The judgement belongs to my patron."*  
> **— Grand Marshal Aurelius, First Champion of the Sacred Host**

## Rank 2
### Description

Your connection to your patron has deepened, allowing greater amounts of divine essence to flow through your weapon without overwhelming your mortal body. Each strike carries more than simple power—it becomes an unmistakable expression of your patron's will upon the battlefield.

As your faith strengthens, the divine energy responds more readily to your conviction. The manifestation of your patron's power burns brighter, strikes harder, and resonates more fiercely against those who stand in opposition to the deity you serve. Though every Paladin channels this miracle differently, all learn that true strength comes not from the weapon itself, but from the sacred bond that empowers it.

Experienced Paladins know that Divine Smite is not meant to be used recklessly. Every invocation is a reminder that divine power is entrusted to them for a purpose, and each empowered strike carries the weight of their oath.

### Effects

- Spend **35 MP** immediately before or immediately after hitting a creature with a melee weapon attack.
- The triggering attack deals an additional **4d8 Patron Damage**.
- Your patron determines the **damage type**, visual manifestation, and other interactions of this damage through its Religious pages.
- If the target belongs to your patron's **Divine Opposition**, increase the additional damage to **5d8 Patron Damage**.
- Divine Smite may only be activated **once per turn**.
- Divine Smite cannot be activated if the triggering attack misses.
- Additional effects granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** are applied after resolving the damage, where applicable.

### Lore

To witness a seasoned Paladin invoke Divine Smite is to see unwavering faith given physical form. The weapon becomes an extension of the deity's purpose, carrying divine judgement with every strike. Though the appearance differs between patrons, the conviction behind the miracle is always unmistakable.

Many holy orders teach that the strength of a Divine Smite is measured not by the destruction it causes, but by the righteousness of the purpose behind it. Only those who remain true to their oath can safely wield greater measures of their patron's power.

> *"Power without purpose is nothing more than destruction. A true smite carries the weight of an oath."*  
> **— Grand Marshal Aurelius, First Champion of the Sacred Host**

## Rank 3
### Description

The bond between you and your patron has grown beyond a simple blessing. When you invoke Divine Smite, your weapon no longer carries only a fleeting spark of divine power—it becomes temporarily infused with your patron's essence, allowing every movement to reflect the sacred purpose of your oath.

For a brief moment, the line between mortal champion and divine servant becomes blurred. Your weapon radiates the unmistakable presence of your patron, and those who oppose its divine will instinctively recoil from its judgement. Whether your deity manifests through radiant light, consuming shadow, spectral souls, celestial fire, or another sacred expression, every strike reminds friend and foe alike that you fight with power greater than your own.

Veteran Paladins often describe this stage of mastery as the moment Divine Smite ceases to be an ability and instead becomes an extension of their faith itself.

### Effects

- Spend **45 MP** immediately before or immediately after hitting a creature with a melee weapon attack.
- The triggering attack deals an additional **6d8 Patron Damage**.
- Your patron determines the **damage type**, visual manifestation, and additional interactions through its Religious pages.
- If the target belongs to your patron's **Divine Opposition**, increase the additional damage to **8d8 Patron Damage**.
- Your weapon remains **Divinely Infused** until the **end of your current turn**.
- If you make another successful melee weapon attack before the end of your turn (such as through an additional Action, Bonus Action, or Opportunity Attack), you may apply **half of the original Divine Smite damage** without paying an additional Mana Cost.
- Divine Smite may only be activated **once per turn**.
- Additional effects granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** are applied after resolving the damage, where applicable.

### Lore

Only the most devoted Paladins learn to sustain their patron's divine essence beyond a single strike. Rather than calling upon fleeting power, they become living conduits through which their deity's judgement briefly enters the mortal world.

Each patron manifests this miracle differently, yet every faith agrees upon one truth: a weapon blessed in this way is no longer merely steel. For those few heartbeats, it becomes a sacred instrument carrying the will of a god.

> *"A single strike may win a duel. A weapon guided by faith changes the course of history."*  
> **— Grand Marshal Aurelius, First Champion of the Sacred Host**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your weapon has become a true vessel of your patron's divine essence. With every invocation of Divine Smite, the power flowing through your weapon is no longer contained within a single blow. Instead, fragments of your deity's will linger upon the battlefield, leaving behind a manifestation that reflects the eternal purpose of the patron you serve.

To witness a master Paladin invoke Divine Smite is to witness a deity briefly touch the mortal world. Whether blazing with radiant light, engulfed in infernal flame, surrounded by spectral souls, or woven with the threads of fate itself, each strike becomes a declaration that your patron's influence cannot be ignored.

Those who stand in opposition to your deity quickly learn that surviving the initial blow is often only the beginning. The divine power released by your weapon continues to shape the battle long after the strike has landed.

### Effects

- Spend **60 MP** immediately before or immediately after hitting a creature with a melee weapon attack.
- The triggering attack deals an additional **8d8 Patron Damage**.
- Your patron determines the **damage type**, visual manifestation, and additional interactions through its Religious pages.
- If the target belongs to your patron's **Divine Opposition**, increase the additional damage to **10d8 Patron Damage**.
- Your weapon remains **Divinely Infused** until the **end of your next turn**.
- While Divinely Infused, the first successful melee weapon attack you make on each turn deals an additional **2d8 Patron Damage** without spending additional Mana.
- After resolving Divine Smite, apply your patron's **Divine Authority** effects, if applicable.
- Divine Smite may only be activated **once per turn**.
- Divine Smite cannot be activated if the triggering attack misses.

### Lore

Only the greatest champions learn to wield Divine Smite with such mastery. Their patron's essence no longer fades after a single strike but lingers around them, transforming every swing of their weapon into a reminder of the sacred oath they uphold.

Across Asteria, tales speak of battlefields forever changed by these miracles. Some tell of radiant scars burned into the earth, others of shadows that lingered for days, while still others describe spectral echoes or impossible twists of fate. Though the manifestations differ, every account agrees upon one truth—the deity had made its presence known.

> *"One strike may bear my oath. Every strike thereafter bears my patron's will."*  
> **— Grand Marshal Aurelius, First Champion of the Sacred Host**

## Rank 5
### Description

Your patron's divine power flows through you without hesitation, transforming every invocation of Divine Smite into a sacred act of judgement. Your weapon ceases to be merely a tool of war and instead becomes a flawless conduit for the will of the deity you serve.

Every strike carries the unmistakable presence of your patron. The battlefield itself bears witness as divine power erupts from your weapon in a manifestation unique to your faith. Those aligned with your patron's Divine Opposition experience the full weight of this judgement, finding themselves unable to escape the eternal conflict between opposing divine powers.

Only the greatest Paladins are entrusted with such authority. They are no longer simply champions chosen by a deity—they are recognised as living avatars of their patron's purpose upon the battlefield, delivering divine judgement with unwavering conviction and absolute faith.

### Effects

- Spend **80 MP** immediately before or immediately after hitting a creature with a melee weapon attack.
- The triggering attack deals an additional **10d8 Patron Damage**.
- Your patron determines the **damage type**, visual manifestation, and additional interactions through its Religious pages.
- If the target belongs to your patron's **Divine Opposition**, increase the additional damage to **12d8 Patron Damage**.
- Your weapon remains **Divinely Infused** until the **end of your next turn**.
- While Divinely Infused, the first successful melee weapon attack you make on each turn deals an additional **2d8 Patron Damage** without spending additional Mana.
- After resolving Divine Smite, apply all effects granted by your patron's **Divine Authority**, including any Rank V enhancements.
- Divine Smite may only be activated **once per turn**.
- Divine Smite cannot be activated if the triggering attack misses.

### Lore

Across the ages, only a select few Paladins have mastered Divine Smite to this degree. Their names are remembered not because of the devastation they wrought, but because every strike embodied the ideals, convictions, and purpose of the deity they served. Entire wars have turned upon a single blow delivered by such champions, not through overwhelming force alone, but through the undeniable authority of the divine.

The manifestation of this miracle differs between every faith, yet all share a common truth: when a legendary Paladin invokes Divine Smite, friend and foe alike understand they are witnessing the direct will of a god expressed through mortal hands.

> *"This is not my judgement. I am merely the hand that delivers it."*  
> **— Grand Marshal Aurelius, First Champion of the Sacred Host**

## Prerequisites
None

## Scaling
See individual rank details.

## Synergy
Information coming soon.

## GM Notes
GM-only information coming soon.

entries.body:
# Hallowed Ground

## Overview
Through unwavering devotion, you call upon your patron to sanctify the land beneath your feet. Divine power spreads across the battlefield, transforming ordinary ground into sacred territory where your patron's influence becomes tangible. Every deity manifests this miracle differently, yet each Hallowed Ground serves the same purpose—to establish a place where the patron's divine will is strongest.

Within this consecrated domain, creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** are welcomed beneath its blessing, their vitality restored by the sacred power flowing through the ground. Those aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** experience the opposite, finding the very land rejecting their presence as divine judgement manifests beneath every step.

To stand within Hallowed Ground is to stand within your patron's realm. Whether that realm radiates brilliant light, echoes with restless souls, blooms with vibrant life, burns with infernal flame, or shimmers with threads of fate depends entirely upon the deity you serve. Though every manifestation is unique, all are unmistakable signs that the battlefield has been claimed by a higher power.

## Rank 1
### Description

Through unwavering devotion, you call upon your patron to sanctify the land beneath your feet. Divine power spreads across the battlefield, transforming ordinary ground into sacred territory where your patron's influence becomes tangible. Every deity manifests this miracle differently, yet each Hallowed Ground serves the same purpose—to establish a place where the patron's divine will is strongest.

Within this consecrated domain, creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** are welcomed beneath its blessing, their vitality restored by the sacred power flowing through the ground. Those aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** experience the opposite, finding the very land rejecting their presence as divine judgement manifests beneath every step.

To stand within Hallowed Ground is to stand within your patron's realm. Whether that realm radiates brilliant light, echoes with restless souls, blooms with vibrant life, burns with infernal flame, or shimmers with threads of fate depends entirely upon the deity you serve. Though every manifestation is unique, all are unmistakable signs that the battlefield has been claimed by a higher power.

### Effects

- Spend **40 MP** to consecrate an area within **10 metres**.
- Create a **5 metre radius Hallowed Ground** that lasts for **3 Rounds**.
- The appearance, damage type, and visual effects are determined by your patron's Religious pages.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** that begin their turn within the Hallowed Ground restore **1d8 + your Charisma Modifier HP**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** that begin their turn within the Hallowed Ground take **1d8 Patron Damage**.
- The exact creatures, followers, summons, and divine entities affected by **Divine Resonance** and **Divine Opposition** are determined by your patron's Religious pages.
- A creature may only benefit from or be damaged by Hallowed Ground **once per round**.
- Additional effects granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** apply while creatures remain within the Hallowed Ground, where applicable.
- Multiple Hallowed Ground effects may overlap, but creatures are only affected by the single strongest Hallowed Ground of each patron.

### Lore

Every faith teaches that the world itself remembers the footsteps of the divine. Through prayer and absolute conviction, a Paladin briefly restores a fragment of that sacred presence, allowing mortal soil to become an extension of their patron's realm. The battlefield itself bends to the deity's influence, welcoming those who walk in harmony with its purpose while rejecting those who oppose it.

Many ancient battlefields throughout Asteria are believed to have remained hallowed for centuries after legendary conflicts. Pilgrims still seek these places, claiming they can feel the lingering presence of the gods long after their champions have departed.

> *"Where my patron's will is welcomed, life is strengthened. Where it is opposed, judgement follows."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Paths**

## Rank 2
### Description

Your patron's influence spreads further across the battlefield, allowing a greater portion of the world to briefly reflect their divine domain. What was once a small sanctuary now becomes a sacred territory where your patron's presence is undeniable, strengthening those who walk in harmony with its purpose while pressing ever harder against those who oppose it.

As your faith deepens, the boundary between the mortal world and your patron's divine realm becomes thinner. Every step taken within the Hallowed Ground reminds creatures aligned with your deity that they stand upon blessed soil, while those bound to opposing divine powers feel an increasing sense of unease as the land itself rejects their presence.

Experienced Paladins learn that battles are not always won through overwhelming force. Sometimes victory comes from claiming the ground beneath your feet and compelling friend and foe alike to fight upon terrain blessed by a higher power.

### Effects

- Spend **50 MP** to consecrate an area within **15 metres**.
- Create a **7 metre radius Hallowed Ground** that lasts for **4 Rounds**.
- The appearance, damage type, and visual effects are determined by your patron's Religious pages.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** that begin their turn within the Hallowed Ground restore **2d8 + your Charisma Modifier HP**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** that begin their turn within the Hallowed Ground take **2d8 Patron Damage**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** suffer a **−2 penalty on Saving Throws** against effects originating from your patron while they remain within the Hallowed Ground.
- The exact creatures, followers, summons, and divine entities affected by **Divine Resonance** and **Divine Opposition** are determined by your patron's Religious pages.
- A creature may only benefit from or be damaged by Hallowed Ground **once per round**.
- Additional effects granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** apply while creatures remain within the Hallowed Ground, where applicable.
- Multiple Hallowed Ground effects may overlap, but creatures are only affected by the single strongest Hallowed Ground of each patron.

### Lore

The greatest temples teach that sacred ground is more than a place of worship—it is a place where the divine feels close enough to touch. As a Paladin's devotion grows, they learn to recreate a fragment of that holy presence wherever they stand, carrying their patron's influence into the heart of battle.

Many ancient battlefields became revered pilgrimage sites because the divine essence left behind by legendary Paladins lingered long after the fighting had ended. Even centuries later, worshippers claim to feel the comforting embrace—or unsettling rejection—of the patron that once claimed that ground.

> *"The world remembers every place the gods have touched. Today, this ground shall remember my patron."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Paths**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your patron's influence no longer merely blesses the battlefield—it begins to reshape it. The sacred domain you create resonates with divine purpose, strengthening those who walk in harmony with your deity while steadily weakening the resolve of those who stand against it.

Within the Hallowed Ground, the boundary between the mortal realm and your patron's divine domain grows thin. Every heartbeat spent upon the consecrated earth reinforces the patron's will. Those aligned with your deity feel renewed with every passing moment, while opposing forces find their strength slowly eroded beneath the overwhelming presence of the divine.

To veteran Paladins, Hallowed Ground becomes more than a place of refuge. It is a declaration that this battlefield has been claimed, and all who enter must answer to the will of the patron who sanctified it.

### Effects

- Spend **60 MP** to consecrate an area within **20 metres**.
- Create a **10 metre radius Hallowed Ground** that lasts for **5 Rounds**.
- The appearance, damage type, and visual effects are determined by your patron's Religious pages.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** that begin their turn within the Hallowed Ground restore **3d8 + your Charisma Modifier HP**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** that begin their turn within the Hallowed Ground take **3d8 Patron Damage**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** suffer a **−4 penalty on Saving Throws** against effects originating from your patron while they remain within the Hallowed Ground.
- Once per turn, creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** may immediately attempt a new Saving Throw against one effect associated with your patron's **Divine Opposition**, gaining a **+2 bonus** on that Saving Throw.
- The exact creatures, followers, summons, and divine entities affected by **Divine Resonance** and **Divine Opposition** are determined by your patron's Religious pages.
- A creature may only benefit from or be damaged by Hallowed Ground **once per round**.
- Additional effects granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** apply while creatures remain within the Hallowed Ground, where applicable.
- Multiple Hallowed Ground effects may overlap, but creatures are only affected by the single strongest Hallowed Ground of each patron.

### Lore

As a Paladin's devotion matures, their patron's influence ceases to be a fleeting blessing and instead becomes a living domain upon the battlefield. Warriors who fight within it often describe feeling as though they stand beneath the direct gaze of the deity itself, their courage renewed while opposing powers seem strangely diminished.

Many of Asteria's holiest battlefields were said to have been transformed by Paladins of this mastery. Even centuries later, pilgrims claim those places still carry echoes of the divine presence that once sanctified them, while creatures opposed to that patron instinctively avoid crossing the ancient ground.

> *"Where my patron walks, the faithful are strengthened and the faithless find no comfort."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Paths**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your patron's influence now extends far beyond a simple blessing upon the land. When you consecrate the battlefield, the ground itself begins to reflect a fragment of your deity's divine realm, strengthening those who embody your patron's ideals while relentlessly rejecting those who stand in opposition.

Within this sacred domain, divine power flows freely. Every step taken by those aligned with your patron renews their strength and conviction, while opposing forces feel the crushing weight of entering territory that no longer welcomes their presence. To them, the very earth seems to resist their advance.

Among the greatest Paladins, Hallowed Ground is considered the ultimate expression of battlefield control. Rather than merely fighting upon the battlefield, they transform the battlefield into an extension of their patron's divine will, allowing every miracle they perform to resonate more strongly within its sacred boundaries.

### Effects

- Spend **75 MP** to consecrate an area within **25 metres**.
- Create a **12 metre radius Hallowed Ground** that lasts for **6 Rounds**.
- The appearance, damage type, and visual manifestation are determined by your patron's Religious pages.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** that begin their turn within the Hallowed Ground restore **4d8 + your Charisma Modifier HP**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** that begin their turn within the Hallowed Ground take **4d8 Patron Damage**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** suffer a **−6 penalty on Saving Throws** against abilities originating from your patron while they remain within the Hallowed Ground.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** gain a **+2 bonus to Saving Throws** against effects originating from your patron's Divine Opposition while they remain within the Hallowed Ground.
- All Paladin talents that reference your patron's **Divine Authority** are considered empowered while used within your Hallowed Ground. Apply any additional effects granted by your patron's Religious pages.
- The exact creatures, followers, summons, and divine entities affected by **Divine Resonance** and **Divine Opposition** are determined by your patron's Religious pages.
- A creature may only benefit from or be damaged by Hallowed Ground **once per round**.
- Multiple Hallowed Ground effects may overlap, but creatures are only affected by the single strongest Hallowed Ground of each patron.

### Lore

Only a handful of Paladins ever reach the point where the world itself bends to reflect their patron's divine influence. Their Hallowed Ground is no longer viewed as a temporary blessing, but as a sacred territory where the deity's presence can almost be felt with every breath.

Many ancient battlefields became holy sites because legendary Paladins fought upon them with such devotion that traces of their patron's influence remained long after the conflict had ended. Pilgrims still journey to these places seeking blessings, while those opposed to the patron often refuse to set foot upon the consecrated ground.

> *"This is no longer mortal soil. For a fleeting moment, you stand within my patron's realm."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Paths**

## Rank 5
### Description

Your faith has reached its pinnacle, allowing your patron to briefly manifest a fragment of their divine realm upon the mortal world. The land itself becomes an extension of your deity's will, transforming the battlefield into sacred territory where their influence reigns supreme.

Every Hallowed Ground is unique to the patron that created it. Some blossom into flourishing sanctuaries overflowing with life, while others become silent graveyards where restless spirits gather. Some shimmer with impossible threads of fate, while others burn with celestial fire or echo with infernal wrath. Though their appearance differs, they all represent the same truth—the world itself has yielded to divine authority.

Those whose souls resonate with your patron find themselves strengthened simply by standing within the domain. Those aligned against your patron feel the land reject their presence, every moment spent within it reminding them they walk upon ground claimed by a higher power.

### Effects

- Spend **90 MP** to consecrate an area within **30 metres**.
- Create a **15 metre radius Hallowed Ground** that lasts for **8 Rounds**.
- The appearance, damage type, and all additional effects are determined by your patron's Religious pages.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** that begin their turn within the Hallowed Ground restore **5d8 + your Charisma Modifier HP**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** that begin their turn within the Hallowed Ground take **5d8 Patron Damage**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** have **Disadvantage on Saving Throws** against abilities originating from your patron while they remain within the Hallowed Ground.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** have **Advantage on Saving Throws** against effects originating from your patron's Divine Opposition while they remain within the Hallowed Ground.
- All Paladin talents that reference your patron's **Divine Authority** are empowered while used within your Hallowed Ground. Apply all Rank V Divine Authority effects described in your patron's Religious pages.
- The exact creatures, followers, summons, and divine entities affected by **Divine Resonance** and **Divine Opposition** are determined by your patron's Religious pages.
- A creature may only benefit from or be damaged by Hallowed Ground **once per round**.
- Multiple Hallowed Ground effects may overlap, but creatures are only affected by the strongest Hallowed Ground belonging to each individual patron.

### Lore

The oldest scriptures speak of legendary champions capable of bringing a fragment of their patron's divine realm into the mortal world. Though only for a few fleeting moments, these sacred domains became places where miracles felt natural and divine judgement seemed inevitable.

Entire civilizations have built temples upon battlefields where such miracles once occurred, believing traces of the patron's presence still linger beneath the soil. Whether these stories are truth or legend, every holy order agrees that no greater expression of a Paladin's devotion exists than to allow their deity's will to reshape the very ground beneath their feet.

> *"For this brief moment, this land no longer belongs to kings or kingdoms. It belongs to my patron."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Paths**

## Prerequisites
None

## Scaling
See individual rank details.

## Synergy
Information coming soon.

## GM Notes
GM-only information coming soon.
